request.description: Train the first goal-aligned PPO policy on the complete official target-radius range with continuity-aligned hold shaping.
request.rationale: The current recipe omits official inner-radius targets and does not forfeit accumulated hold progress after an interruption. This fresh run tests whether complete radial coverage plus a strong continuity signal produces a policy that can reach and sustain the required hold; its next decision will be based on development success and phase-resolved hold diagnostics.
